answer: Language test score with testing body attestation is the check: a score on record with the testing body. A farm faking 396 aliases needs 396 separate verifiable records of this kind, each checked against the issuing authority, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The raven test is the price tag: 396 fakes mean 396 payments. The record is checked live against the issuing authority each epoch, and a revoked or missing entry loses the seat. The whisper signal is visible to every grader, and the ember ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
